mapper.select: SELECT like_type FROM content_like WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}::integer
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_like (member_id, target_type, target_id, like_type, reg_id, reg_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}::integer, #{likeType}, #{regId}, NOW(), #{regIp}) ON CONFLICT (member_id, target_type, target_id) DO NOTHING

choose.when: SELECT post_id::TEXT FROM post WHERE post_id = #{targetId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
choose.otherwise: SELECT c.post_id::TEXT FROM comment c JOIN post p ON p.post_id = c.post_id AND p.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE c.comment_id = #{targetId}::integer AND c.use_yn = 'Y'

choose.when: SELECT COALESCE(good_cnt, 0)::TEXT AS good_cnt, COALESCE(bad_cnt, 0)::TEXT AS bad_cnt FROM post WHERE post_id = #{targetId}::integer
choose.otherwise: SELECT COALESCE(good_cnt, 0)::TEXT AS good_cnt, COALESCE(bad_cnt, 0)::TEXT AS bad_cnt FROM comment WHERE comment_id = #{targetId}::integer
